prior: B07 passed four original Congress source vote JSONs; code does not validate `totales` is mapping, seat canonical form or fully disallow extra data.
H1: Mutation of source original rows/counts/types always causes intentional source-validation ValueError; no unexpected low-level exception or silent acceptance of corrupted original aggregate structure.
H0: Some source schema corruptions bypass checks or raise unexpected exceptions, indicating fail-closed error-contract gap.
method: From first original JSON in private ZIP, deep-copy in memory and apply 8 predetermined mutation classes: wrong total, duplicated real seat, unsupported vote, seat wrong type, negative nonsentinel, missing totals map, null totals, positive noncanonical leading-zero seat. Report each result; distinguish informative failure from unintended error or inadvertent accept. If genuine defect, implement guarded input schema and add targeted unit tests, verify exact source again. No names/vote exports.
acceptance: Eight classes examined with deterministic outcome; newly found defect leads to narrow patch/test; no retrospective user-facing readiness percent changes.
